problem_statement: jgchenu/bootstrap-blog-template is a static Bootstrap 3 editorial blog template (Corlate: Bootstrap + jQuery + Font Awesome) served directly from static HTML files with a dark inverse navbar (Home, About Us, Services, Portfolio, Pages, Blog, Contact), a blog list page with post cards and a sidebar, and a shared footer. Add a genre-native Filter posts control to the blog feed: a chip bar mounted above the post list (blog.html) with topic chips (All, Tech, Design, Travel, Food, Culture) and a live result readout 'Showing N of 8 . <Topic>' over a grid of 8 categorized post cards (title, topic, excerpt). Clicking a topic chip must filter the post grid to that topic AND recompute the readout (e.g. 'Showing 2 of 8 . Tech'). The same Filter posts bar appears as a compact teaser on the Home and About pages so topic browsing stays continuous across the site. The chip row must be responsive (wrap on a 390px phone with no horizontal overflow), and the post grid must render as a tidy multi-column grid with legible card titles and readable active-chip contrast. Keep the template's red-accent design language, navbar, sidebar, and footer intact.
required_content: The blog feed shows a 'Filter posts' chip bar with six topic chips and a live 'Showing N of 8 . <Topic>' readout above a grid of 8 categorized post cards.
Clicking a topic chip filters the post grid AND updates the readout; clicking Tech yields 'Showing 2 of 8 . Tech'.
The Filter posts bar is present on the Blog, Home, and About pages (cross-page continuity).
At 390px the chip row wraps and the page has no horizontal overflow; the post grid stays a tidy legible multi-column grid on desktop with readable active-chip contrast.
Each post card shows its title, topic label, and a short excerpt with its thumbnail.
No new JavaScript console errors or failed network requests (beyond the template's pre-existing carousel/maps behavior) are introduced on any captured page.
design_constraints: Preserve the Corlate blog design language: white background, red (#d9534f) accent, dark inverse navbar, sidebar, and footer.
The Filter posts bar must ride above the blog post feed it controls (blog.html) and as a compact teaser on Home + About; do not make it a separate page or hero banner.
The topic chip row must be responsive (wrap / flexible chips), not a fixed-width nowrap row that overflows the mobile viewport.

The post grid must be a tidy multi-column grid; cards must not shingle or overlap via negative margins, and card titles / active-chip text must stay legible (no near-black-on-dark or near-white-on-near-white).
Clicking a chip must recompute the readout from the active topic; a frozen/stale readout that never updates is a defect.
Only the Filter-posts markup/stylesheet/script and its per-page presence change between legs; the shared navbar, sidebar, and footer stay the same.
state_constraints: desktop_blog captures the blog page at 1440px: the Filter posts bar renders six topic chips in one tidy responsive row above a legible multi-column post grid, active chip readable, readout 'Showing 8 of 8 . All topics'.
mobile_blog captures the same page at 390px: the responsive chip row wraps and the page has no horizontal overflow (a fixed-width nowrap chip row would push the document wider than the viewport).
desktop_home and desktop_about capture the Home and About pages, each showing the compact Filter posts teaser (cross-page continuity).
desktop_blog_tech captures the blog page after clicking the Tech chip: the grid filters to 2 posts and the readout recomputes to 'Showing 2 of 8 . Tech'.
Source inspection confirms a static Bootstrap blog; the Filter posts bar lives inline in blog.html, its layout in css/pf.css, and its behavior in js/pf.js.

change_completion: The blog feed shows the Filter posts bar with six topic chips and a live 'Showing N of 8 . <Topic>' readout above an 8-post grid.
Clicking the Tech chip filters the grid to 2 posts and updates the readout to 'Showing 2 of 8 . Tech'.
The Filter posts bar appears on the Blog, Home, and About pages.
design_consistency: The bar keeps the template's white/red palette, navbar, sidebar, and footer.
The post grid is a tidy multi-column grid with legible card titles and readable active-chip contrast (no overlap, no dark-on-dark).
Desktop and tablet appearance of the bar and grid are preserved.
regression: The navbar, sidebar widgets, post links, and footer remain functional and reachable.
No new console errors or failed network requests (beyond the template's pre-existing carousel/maps behavior) are introduced on any captured page.
responsive: At 390px the chip row wraps and the page has no horizontal overflow or clipped chips.
The post grid collapses cleanly to a single column on mobile without overlapping cards.

author_notes: Repo-grounded static Bootstrap editorial blog (jgchenu/bootstrap-blog-template, Corlate theme). capability=Add a genre-native Filter posts topic filter over the blog feed: topic chips + a live 'Showing N of 8' readout + a filtered post grid, plus a compact teaser on Home and About. The three legs vary only in the Filter-posts markup in blog.html, css/pf.css (chip-row responsiveness + post-grid layout), js/pf.js (filter wiring), and the per-page presence of the compact bar on index.html/about-us.html. Reference: responsive wrapping chip row, tidy legible multi-column grid, live readout, bar on all three pages. The shared navbar, sidebar, footer, and blog imagery are declared infrastructure, identical across all three legs. Served directly as static files; reference is runtime-clean (0 new console errors, 0 failed requests beyond the template's pre-existing about-us carousel call and contact-page maps embed) across all captured pages.
